name: Israel Becoming A State
overview: Scripture foretells God's sovereign plan to restore Israel as a nation, promising to gather His scattered people from all corners of the earth and bring them back to their land. Prophets like Isaiah and Ezekiel vividly describe this divine regathering as a miraculous birth of a nation, emphasizing God's compassion and faithfulness to His covenant people. This restoration is portrayed not merely as a political event but as a fulfillment of God's redemptive purposes, demonstrating His power to revive and preserve His chosen people.
